info.title: apgw — Agentic Payment Gateway
info.description: Policy, settlement and evidence control plane between AI agents and any payment rail. Agents authenticate with a bearer credential (and, when holder-bound, an RFC 9421 signature); operators with an admin token.

credential.description: base64url credential (macaroon-style). If the credential carries a holder_key caveat, the request must also carry Signature-Input/Signature (RFC 9421, Ed25519, tag apgw-holder) and Content-Digest for bodies.

maxAmount.description: Ceiling in human units, e.g. '0.05'. A ceiling, not a price.

approvalId.description: Resume an escalated intent under a granted approval

PayResult.description: ok, status, rail, payloadKind, intent, decision, onchain, settlement, pending, receipts[], body, error

get.summary: Liveness, gateway address, active policy versions
Web Bot Auth key directory (signed response)
Gateway signing keys as a JWK Set

post.summary: Issue and register a root credential for an agent
Attenuate the caller's credential (optionally delegating) and register it
Register an offline-attenuated credential (compiles an on-chain session)

get.summary: Public view of the caller's credential and its on-chain session

post.summary: Dry-run: fetch the 402 quote, decide, ask the account contract; nothing is paid
Pay for a resource under policy (x402 or MPP). 202 = approval required
Continue an escalated payment under a granted approval
Open a subscription (MPP): the first charge pays now; the payee may charge later within the terms

get.summary: List subscriptions: a credential sees those opened in its own lineage; the admin token sees a whole principal

post.summary: Cancel a subscription (own lineage, or the admin token with principalId); further payee charges are refused with 410
Payee charges a subscription (Bearer charge token). Policy runs on every charge; settled on-chain by the gateway
